page_title: ARG 2-1 AUS | Argentina v Australia 03/12/2022, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.

90+7' Garang Kuol (Australia) meets a cross inside the penalty area and unloads a good attempt towards the right side of the goal. Emiliano Martinez is prepared, though, and denies him with a fantastic save.

90+4' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Mathew Ryan shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
90+3' A great run from Lionel Messi (Argentina) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post.
90+3' Mathew Ryan pulls off a great save to deny Lautaro Martinez (Argentina), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
90' 7 additional min. will be played.
90' Harry Souttar (Australia) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.
89' Lionel Messi sprays a pass out to Lautaro Martinez (Argentina), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes high over the bar.
88' Lautaro Martinez (Argentina) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
86' Harry Souttar (Australia) makes a rough challenge and Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle for a foul.
85' Lionel Messi (Argentina) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
82' Australia can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
81' Aziz Behich (Australia) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag and Australia will take a corner.
80' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Exequiel Palacios (Argentina) will replace Nahuel Molina.
80' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alexis Mac Allister trots off the pitch and is replaced by Gonzalo Montiel (Argentina).
79' Nicolas Tagliafico (Argentina) is adjudged offside.
77' 2 - 1 Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) scores an unlucky own goal! He deflects a shot into his own net.
75' Lautaro Martinez plays a pass to Nicolas Tagliafico (Argentina), but he fails to get a decent shot away from inside the box and the ball flies well wide of the right post.
71' Marcos Acuna comes off the pitch to be replaced by Nicolas Tagliafico (Argentina).
71' Lionel Scaloni decides to make a substitution. Julian Alvarez will be replaced by Lautaro Martinez (Argentina).
71' Substitution. Milos Degenek is replaced by Fran Karacic (Australia).
71' Here is a change. Mitchell Duke is going off and Graham Arnold gives the last tactical orders to Jamie Maclaren (Australia).
71' Substitution. Garang Kuol (Australia) has come on for Mathew Leckie.
69' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) commits a foul and Szymon Marciniak immediately signals a free kick.
68' Craig Goodwin (Australia) sends the free kick into the box, but Emiliano Martinez leaps to intercept it.
66' Lionel Messi (Argentina) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
66' Marcos Acuna (Argentina) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Julian Alvarez, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
65' Rodrigo de Paul (Argentina) works the corner short.
65' Lionel Messi (Argentina) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Argentina force their opponents to concede a corner.
63' Ajdin Hrustic (Australia) takes the free kick and sends the ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready.
62' Szymon Marciniak couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Cristian Gabriel Romero (Argentina) and blew his whistle. Australia are awarded the free kick.
58' Graham Arnold has decided to make a change. Craig Goodwin (Australia) replaces Riley McGree.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ajdin Hrustic (Australia) comes onto the pitch for Keanu Baccus.
57' 2 - 0 Goal! Mathew Ryan makes a huge mistake and Julian Alvarez (Argentina) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 2:0.
56' Mathew Ryan displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Lionel Messi (Argentina) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
54' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Riley McGree (Australia).

50' Lionel Messi (Argentina) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Mathew Ryan pulls off an easy save.
50' The substitution has been made. Lisandro Martinez (Argentina) has replaced Papu Gomez.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
41' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 2:1. Shots on target – 1:0.
38' Milos Degenek (Australia) will miss the next game.
38' Milos Degenek (Australia) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Szymon Marciniak didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
35' 1 - 0 Fantastic team goal! Lionel Messi (Argentina) was set free in the area by Nicolas Otamendi and he made no mistake with a lovely finish into the bottom left corner. 1:0.
35' Lionel Messi (Argentina) whips in the free kick, but one of the defenders comfortably clears the ball away.

34' The game is interrupted. Aziz Behich (Australia) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Argentina get a free kick.
32' Keanu Baccus (Australia) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
32' Aaron Mooy (Australia) sends in a poor free kick and the ball goes out of play. Back to the drawing board.
31' Szymon Marciniak blows his whistle. Marcos Acuna (Argentina) commits a foul after dangerous play. Australia win a free kick.
29' Harry Souttar (Australia) meets the corner with a powerful well-placed header that beats the keeper, but the close-range effort is superbly blocked on the goal line by a defender. Unlucky!
29' Riley McGree (Australia) will take a corner kick.

28' A lofted cross from Jackson Irvine (Australia) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The ball goes out of play and Australia have been awarded a corner kick.
27' Australia seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
24' Aaron Mooy (Australia) takes the resulting corner which is well defended.
23' Mathew Leckie (Australia) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Australia get a corner.
19' Aziz Behich (Australia) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Papu Gomez (Argentina) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
15' Jackson Irvine (Australia) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
15' The foul by Jackson Irvine (Australia) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Szymon Marciniak.
13' Julian Alvarez (Argentina) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
11' Nahuel Molina (Argentina) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play.
10' Enzo Fernandez (Argentina) tries to find Julian Alvarez, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
7' Szymon Marciniak blows for a foul after Keanu Baccus (Australia) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
4' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Papu Gomez (Argentina).
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Australia will take the kick-off.
Szymon Marciniak got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
